title: Mistral Large 4 - Mistral AI
excerpt: Mistral Large 4 is a state-of-the-art, open-weight, general-purpose multimodal model with a granular Mixture-of-Experts architecture. It features 52B active parameters and 1.05T total parameters, and a 1.6B vision encoder.
